units.source_text: 小君睡在附近，源氏公子便催他起身。

en.t: Kogimi was sleeping nearby, so Prince Genji urged him to get up.

units.source_text: 他因有心事，不曾睡熟，立刻醒了。

en.t: Because he had something on his mind, he had not been sleeping soundly and woke at once.

units.source_text: 起来把门打开，忽听见一个老侍女高声问道：“是谁？”

en.t: He got up and opened the door, when suddenly he heard an old maidservant ask loudly, "Who is it?"

units.source_text: 小君讨厌她，答道：“是我。”

en.t: Kogimi disliked her and answered, "It is me."

units.source_text: 老侍女说：“您半夜三更到哪里去？”

en.t: The old maidservant said, "Where are you going in the middle of the night?"

units.source_text: 她表示关心，跟着走出来。

en.t: Showing concern, she followed him out.

units.source_text: 小君越发讨厌她了，回答说：“不到哪里去，就在这里走走。”

en.t: Kogimi disliked her all the more and replied, "Nowhere in particular. I am just walking around here."

units.source_text: 连忙推源氏公子出去。

en.t: He hurriedly pushed Prince Genji outside.

units.source_text: 时候将近天亮，晓月犹自明朗，照遍各处。

en.t: It was nearly dawn, and the morning moon was still bright, shining over everything.

units.source_text: 那老侍女忽然看见另一个人影，又问：“还有一位是谁？”

en.t: The old maidservant suddenly saw another figure and asked again, "And who is the other one?"

units.source_text: 立刻自己回答道：“是民部姑娘吧。

en.t: She immediately answered herself, "It must be Lady Minbu.

units.source_text: 身材好高大呀！”

en.t: How very tall she is!"

units.source_text: 民部是一个侍女。

en.t: Minbu was a maidservant.

units.source_text: 这人个子很高，常常被人取笑。

en.t: She was very tall and was often teased for it.

units.source_text: 这老侍女以为是民部陪着小君出去。

en.t: The old maidservant thought Minbu was accompanying Kogimi outside.

units.source_text: “不消多时，小少爷也长得这么高了。”

en.t: "Before long, the young master will be this tall too."

units.source_text: 她说着，自己也走出门去。

en.t: As she said this, she herself also went out the door.

units.source_text: 源氏公子狼狈得很，却又不能叫这老侍女进去，就在过廊门口阴暗地方站定了。

en.t: Prince Genji was terribly embarrassed, but he could not tell the old maidservant to go back in, so he stood still in the shadowed place by the corridor entrance.

units.source_text: 老侍女走近他身边来，向他诉苦：“你是今天来值班的么？

en.t: The old maidservant came close to him and began complaining, "Are you on duty today?

units.source_text: 我前天肚子痛得厉害，下去休息了；可是上头说人太少，要我来伺候，昨天又来了。

en.t: The day before yesterday my stomach hurt terribly, so I went off to rest; but the people above said there were too few attendants and told me to come serve, so I came again yesterday.

units.source_text: 身体还是吃不消呢。”

en.t: My body still cannot bear it."

units.source_text: 不等对方回答，又叫道：“啊唷，肚子好痛啊！

en.t: Without waiting for an answer, she cried out again, "Oh, my stomach hurts so much!

units.source_text: 回头见吧。”

en.t: I will see you later."

units.source_text: 便回屋子里去。

en.t: Then she went back into the room.

units.source_text: 源氏公子好容易脱身而去。

en.t: Prince Genji finally managed to get away.

units.source_text: 他心中想：“这种行径，毕竟是轻率而危险的。”

en.t: He thought to himself, "Behavior like this is, after all, rash and dangerous."

units.source_text: 便更加警惕了。

en.t: So he became even more cautious.
